items.title: US and French nationals test positive for hantavirus after leaving ship
items.description: The American national has arrived in Nebraska, while a French woman is isolating in Paris.

items.title: Portrait looted by Nazis found in home of Dutch SS leader's descendants
items.description: The painting is believed to have been plundered by high-ranking Nazi Hermann Goering during World War Two.

items.title: Washington dinner shooting suspect pleads not guilty
items.description: Cole Tomas Allen, 31, was charged with attempting to assassinate US President Donald Trump.

items.title: Whales could be harmed by diverted ships avoiding Middle East, scientists warn
items.description: Ships have rerouted around the Cape of Good Hope since 2023 to avoid conflicts in the Middle East.

items.title: Trump calls Iran response to US proposal to end war 'totally unacceptable'
items.description: Iran is reported to want lifting of the US naval blockade, recognition of Iranian sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz and compensation for war damage.

items.title: Dozens of Nigerian fishermen feared dead after Chad air strikes on Boko Haram
items.description: A fishermen's leader tells the BBC that 40 people are feared dead  - either in the strikes or drowning as they tried to flee.

items.title: Philippine VP Sara Duterte impeached for a second time
items.description: If convicted in a Senate trial, which is uncertain, she will be disqualified from running for president.

items.title: Bosnia's powerful peace envoy quits, with questions over role's future
items.description: Christian Schmidt had been in the role since 2021, and departs after appearing to lose the backing of the United States.

items.title: Ailing Iranian Nobel laureate given bail and hospital transfer
items.description: Iranian authorities granted human rights activist Narges Mohammadi bail amid growing concern over her poor health in prison.

items.title: His father had just been buried. Then West Bank settlers forced him to dig up the body
items.description: The UN human rights office condemns incident as "'appalling and emblematic of the dehumanisation of Palestinians" in the West Bank.

items.title: Police find body believed to be of fugitive Australian shooter
items.description: A body found in New South Wales is thought to be that of a man wanted over a triple murder.

items.title: Iran activists tell BBC how threat of war intensifies trauma of repression
items.description: A dissident in Tehran says she feels helpless and under immense psychological pressure.
